title: Meshfree GMsFEM-based exponential integration for multiscale 3D advection-diffusion problems
summary: In this work, we extend the meshfree generalized multiscale exponential integration framework introduced in Nikiforov et al. (2025) to the simulation of three-dimensional advection--diffusion problems in heterogeneous and high-contrast media. The proposed approach combines meshfree generalized multiscale finite element methods (GMsFEM) for spatial discretization with exponential integration techniques for time advancement, enabling stable and efficient computations in the presence of stiffness induced by multiscale coefficients and transport effects.
